message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the fact: From Jan to March 2014, defendant Zhang gave kickbacks to two officials (Liu and Huang) totaling 94,192 yuan after completing wall engineering for a real estate company. This is bribery (受贿) because the defendant gave money to public officials? The recipients are project comprehensive department deputy general manager and project engineering (supervision) department deputy manager. They are corporate employees, not public officials. In Chinese law, bribery (受贿) applies to public officials. If they are corporate employees, it's commercial bribery? Could be "行贿" (giving bribe) by the contractor to the company's staff to obtain business. The defendant is the one giving bribe, so the crime is "行贿". The recipients receive bribe, but the fact only mentions the defendant giving bribe. So the crime is "行贿罪". Also possibly "非法经营" but not indicated. So answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: The amount is 94,192 yuan, which is above the threshold for "行贿罪" (any amount). So yes.

Thus final answer: - 单个罪名: [罪名]行贿<eoa>
